title: Qrow: payments that stay safe after Q-Day
note: One clip per shot. `caption` is what viewers read (captions match it exactly). `tts` is what the voice is given: the same words with phonetic spellings so names are said right (Qrow = crow, QoreChain = core-chain, QoreX = core-ex, QOR = core, fUSD = F-U-S-D, ML-DSA spelled out). Voice: edge-tts en-US-AndrewNeural (ElevenLabs Bella until its free credits ran out, 19 Nov). Target pace about 150 words per minute; `seconds` is the scene's planned length. Cut 2 (13 Nov): built around the owner's own screen recording (raw/owner-clean.mp4: connect, swap, send form) plus automated clips.

shots.visual: Black, then the Qrow logo resolves. Title: Payments that stay safe after Q-Day.
shots.caption: One day, quantum computers will break the signatures that protect today's crypto payments. Qrow is built for that day.

shots.visual: The Start page on qrow-app.vercel.app, slow scroll over 'What you can try'.
shots.caption: Qrow is an escrow payments app on QoreChain testnet. Every payment waits safely in escrow until it's claimed, and every step is signed with a quantum-safe key, ML-DSA-87.

shots.visual: Owner recording: Connect QoreX, the QoreX connect popup, Connect; the Faucet tab with the connected address.
shots.caption: Connect QoreX once and approve. You're in, and your faucet address is ready for free test tokens.

shots.visual: Owner recording: Swap tab, type 20 QOR, live quote, Review swap, QoreX approval popup (Swap, memo 'Qrow swap'), Swap confirmed receipt with hash.
shots.caption: Let's swap twenty QOR for fUSD. Qrow quotes from the chain itself, so you see the minimum you'll receive, the fee and the price impact before you sign. Review, approve once in QoreX, and the swap is confirmed, with a receipt and its hash.

shots.visual: Owner recording: Send form, paste the recipient, type 12 fUSD, release mode, the confirm screen (stops before the click). Then the automated Verify of payment QRW-PAY-000003.
shots.caption: Sending is just as simple. Paste the recipient's address, type the amount, and choose how it's released. The confirm screen checks the address for lookalikes and shows exactly where the money goes. Here's a real Qrow payment on testnet, read straight from the escrow contract.

shots.visual: Owner recording: Receive tab, Request a payment with its QR code and Copy link.
shots.caption: To get paid, share a payment link or QR code. The recipient claims with their own quantum-safe signature.

shots.visual: Press Verify on testnet on a receipt: the Verify page shows Confirmed, the signer, 'ML-DSA-87 hybrid signature, verified by the chain', the decoded step.
shots.caption: Every action ends with a receipt and its transaction hash. Paste any hash into Verify, and Qrow reads it straight from the testnet: who signed, the ML-DSA-87 signature the chain verified, and what the contract did.

shots.visual: Tier-1 takeover card: a classical signature cracks, the ML-DSA-87 signature holds; 'Every Qrow action carries both'.
shots.caption: Why it matters: today's signatures can be forged once quantum computers arrive. ML-DSA-87 can't. Every Qrow action carries both.

shots.visual: Live site, UI v2, the owner's address in a read-only view: Hub, Portfolio with Genesis #1, NFT Market, Staking, Launch.
shots.caption: There's more to try: the Qrow Hub, your Genesis NFT in Portfolio, the NFT Market, staking, a coin launcher with anti-scam checks, perps trading and predictions.

shots.visual: End card: Qrow logo, qrow-app.vercel.app, github.com/Terhemba10/qrow, 'Built in Doha, Qatar', 'Public beta: QoreChain testnet, tokens have no value', 'Voiceover: AI-generated (Microsoft Edge neural voice)', 'Music: Good Days by Aylex (freetouse.com)'.
shots.caption: Qrow. Payments that stay safe after Q-Day. Built in Doha, Qatar, for QoreChain's Build Before Q-Day fest. Try it free on testnet.
